title.narrative: The Rule of Law Programme in the Kyrgyz Republic – 2nd phase (ROLPRO 2)

description.narrative: The focus of the Action is on the implementation of the judicial reform in the Kyrgyz Republic. The overall objective is to improve justice and rule of law strengthening the capacity of institutions to deliver and the capacity of citizens to claim their rights through modernising the legislative process and improving the work of judiciary and prosecution.
